scientific_integrity: The proof establishes the family-wide fixed-scale feasibility, universal optimal scale, and source zero-set transition; finite symbolic tests supplement but do not establish infinite-parameter conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for centered isotropic Pearson--VII stationary targets under complete independent Poisson resetting; no energetic cost, finite-sample analysis or arbitrary anisotropic generalization. Broad literature priority remains subject to independent review.
title: A universal reset-rate floor and a center-to-shell transition for Student-type harmonic steady states
